TatyanaAbout.title: Acoustic Sounds
TatyanaAbout.paragraph1: TetJANa Acoustic Sounds is an acoustic duo that creates intimate musical experiences through expressive vocals and masterful guitar performance.
TatyanaAbout.paragraph2: The duo brings together <tetiana>Tetiana Makarova</tetiana> (vocals & percussion), originally from Ukraine, and <jan>Jan Gnyp</jan> (guitar), from Upper Silesia, Germany.
TatyanaAbout.paragraph3: Their repertoire blends international music with original compositions, moving effortlessly between folk, jazz, emotional ballads, and vibrant acoustic arrangements.
TatyanaAbout.paragraph4: Inspired by the richness of Slavic musical traditions, TetJANa Acoustic Sounds combines heartfelt melancholy with warmth, hope, and joy.
TatyanaAbout.paragraph5: Whether performing on a concert stage or during life’s most meaningful celebrations, the duo creates a warm and personal atmosphere that stays with audiences long after the final note.

Biography.title: My Story
Biography.paragraph1: Music has always been more than a profession to me—it is a way to connect, express emotions, and inspire others. As a vocal coach and performer, I believe that every voice is unique and deserves to be heard with confidence. My lessons are designed to help students develop healthy vocal technique, strengthen their musicality, and build the confidence to perform on stage or simply enjoy singing in everyday life. Whether you are a complete beginner or an experienced singer, I create a supportive environment where learning feels inspiring and enjoyable.
Biography.paragraph2: Over the years, I have worked with students of different ages and skill levels, helping them discover their authentic sound and achieve their personal goals. My teaching approach combines technical training, creativity, and individual attention, allowing each student to progress at their own pace. For me, teaching is not only about improving vocal skills—it is about encouraging self-expression, building confidence, and sharing the joy of music. I look forward to being part of your musical journey.

Philosophy.title: My Philosophy
Philosophy.paragraph1: I believe that every singer has a unique voice and story to tell. My approach to vocal coaching is centered around helping singers find their authentic voice, while also developing the technical skills necessary to perform with confidence and emotion.
Philosophy.paragraph2: Through personalized coaching, I help singers explore their vocal range, improve their breath control, and develop their own style and interpretation of songs. I also emphasize the importance of stage presence and performance techniques, so that singers can connect with their audience and deliver a memorable performance.
Philosophy.paragraph3: Whether you're a beginner or an experienced performer, my goal is to help you unlock your full potential as a singer and express yourself through music.

PrivacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPolicy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how personal data is collected and processed when you use this website or submit a booking request.

data.name: Name

purpose.title: 3. Purpose of Processing
purpose.text: This information is processed in order to receive and respond to your booking request, communicate with you regarding your lesson, and arrange the requested service.

resend.title: 4. Email Delivery – Resend
resend.text: This website uses Resend to deliver booking requests by email. Information submitted through the booking form may therefore be processed by Resend for the purpose of delivering the message.

vercel.title: 5. Hosting – Vercel
vercel.text: This website is hosted using Vercel. When you access the website, technical information such as your IP address, browser information, device information, request data and timestamps may be processed as necessary to provide, secure and operate the website.

youtube.title: 6. Embedded Content – YouTube
youtube.text: This website may contain embedded videos provided by YouTube. When you interact with embedded content, information may be transmitted to YouTube and its associated services.

retention.title: 7. Data Retention
retention.text: Personal data submitted through the booking form is retained only for as long as necessary to process your request, communicate with you and fulfil any applicable legal obligations.

rights.title: 8. Your Rights
rights.text: Under applicable data protection law, including the GDPR, you may have the right to request access to your personal data, rectification or deletion of your data, restriction of processing, data portability, or to object to certain processing. You may also have the right to lodge a complaint with a competent data protection supervisory authority.

contact.text: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or the processing of your personal data, please contact:
